long_biography.plain_text:
Allen Exploration has turned Carl A. Allen's interest in diving and shipwrecks into a research programme in the northern Bahamas. Working under Bahamian survey and excavation licences, its team studies the scattered remains of the seventeenth-century Spanish galleon Nuestra Señora de las Maravillas. It also documents other wreck sites across the Little Bahama Bank.

Carl and Gigi Allen also founded the Bahamas Maritime Museum in Freeport to conserve and display recovered material rather than disperse it. The museum combines the Maravillas collection with broader accounts of Lucayan life, Atlantic slavery and Bahamian maritime history. Allen's purchase and rebuilding of Walker's Cay added a revived fishing marina and base for his continuing work in the northern islands.
